kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتفرعن (form IIq)
# أَتَفَرْعَنُ (ʔatafarʕanu) /ʔa.ta.far.ʕa.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَفَرْعَنَ (tafarʕana)
# أَتَفَرْعَنَ (ʔatafarʕana) /ʔa.ta.far.ʕa.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَرْعَنَ (tafarʕana)
# أَتَفَرْعَنْ (ʔatafarʕan) /ʔa.ta.far.ʕan/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَفَرْعَنَ (tafarʕana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
